name: Wu ZiXu
source: He came from the Kingdom of Chu. The King of Chu executed his family and clansmen when he was a boy, and his hair turned white overnight. HéLǘ brought him up, and his only mission in life is to help FuChai break the sacred vow with the Dragon God. He is highly wary but reliable.
